material.alchemical_power.t1_panakeia_in: A metal alchemically dyed blue. It's usually derived from copper, though it’s not bronze or anything of the sort.

Grants +20% durability and, per level, +0.25 attack damage, projectile damage, and defense. Also provides +10% mining speed, attack speed, bow draw speed, and armor toughness. T1 has Level 1 of this trait and additionally shares the same properties as copper.
material.alchemical_power.t2_panakeia_in: A metal alchemically dyed yellow. Usually made from iron. Definitely not gold.
T2 has Level 2 of this trait and additionally shares the same properties as iron.
material.alchemical_power.t3_panakeia_in: A metal alchemically dyed red. Usually made from gold. Has nothing to do with Redstone.
T3 has Level 3 of this trait and additionally shares the same properties as gold.
material.alchemical_power.t4_panakeia_ge: A gemstone alchemically dyed purple. Even when processed from metal, it somehow becomes a gem.
Tier 4 has Level 4 of this trait, and additionally comes pre-upgraded with diamond upgrade and a bonus effect.
material.alchemical_power.t5_panakeia_ge: A gemstone alchemically dyed blue. To uncover its mystery, we alchemists ventured deep into the Amazon jungle—.
Tier 5 has Level 5 of this trait, and additionally comes pre-upgraded with emerald upgrade and a bonus effect.
material.alchemical_power.t6_panakeia_in: A metal alchemically dyed white. Alchemy can even imbue Nether metals with holiness, but this one feels a bit too white.
Tier 6 has Level 6 of this trait, and additionally comes pre-upgraded with netherite upgrade and a bonus effect.
material.alchemical_power.unite_alloy.fl: There’s the question: “If you mix all the colors of the rainbow, does it become white? Or black?” But in the world of mods, it’s quite common for it to just stay rainbow-colored.
material.alchemical_power.unite_alloy.en: “Concerning this alloy, I have discovered a truly remarkable property, but this margin is too narrow to contain it.“  ――Nectios
material.alchemical_power.singularity.fl: Try searching for “singularity” in JEI or similar. How many results did you get?
material.alchemical_power.singularity.en: From light that fills the heavens comes the　sevenfold deadly power, armor that defends all, and all knowledge.
modifier.alchemical_power.panakeia.descr: Materials enhanced by alchemy are just a little bit tougher, just a little bit stronger, and just a little bit lighter.
modifier.alchemical_power.superpolymeriz: Almost all the alloy material's characteristics packed in!
modifier.alchemical_power.singularity.de: Seven strikes to destroy all, and shield against all.
modifier.alchemical_power.akashic_record: You can cram knowledge... specifically up to 10 modifiers each.
tooltip.alchemical_power.confectionbybak: In other words, this is... a Japanese confection made by baking a dough of dissolved flour in a circular mold, filled with sweet bean paste.
item.alchemical_power.japaneseconfection: Japanese confection made of wheat-flour batter filled with sweet bean paste or other fillings baked in a circular cast-iron mold compressed into one from forty-one pieces
tooltip.alchemical_power.jcmowfbfwsbpoof: In Japan, the official name for the original version of this confectionery has not been settled, and heated debates continue day and night.
